scripts.test:integration: npx mocha --require test/setup.js --ui bdd test/integration/**/*.test.js || echo 'No integration tests found'
scripts.test:security: npx mocha --require test/setup.js --ui bdd test/security/**/*.test.js || echo 'No security tests found'
scripts.test:e2e: npx playwright test || echo 'Playwright not fully set up'
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:security && npm run test:e2e
